stem.text: A large excess of marble chips is reacted with $25\,\text{cm}^{3}$ of $1.0\,\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ hydrochloric acid at $40\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$.
How is the result different when the reaction is repeated with $60\,\text{cm}^{3}$ of $0.5\,\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ hydrochloric acid at $40\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$?

A.text: The reaction is faster and more of the products are made when the reaction is complete.

B.text: The reaction is faster and less of the products are made when the reaction is complete.

C.text: The reaction is slower and more of the products are made when the reaction is complete.

D.text: The reaction is slower and less of the products are made when the reaction is complete.
